boundaries.label: Feature slices — one capability, one directory · WALL: depguard slice-isolation denies every cross-slice import
Platform — depguard platform-no-features: serves features, never consumes them
Kernel + River state — in the domain-pure allow-list ($gostd + internal/shared)

cards.title: Vertical slices
items: internal/features/<slice> ships the same files, always: domain.go · ports.go · usecase.go · http.go · postgres.go · queries.sql · module.go
module.go Register(r chi.Router, Deps) is the whole wiring contract; chi.URLParam reads the same {id} wildcards ServeMux did, so handlers stay net/http
adding a slice = one directory + queries.sql + golang-migrate migration + make generate + one line in cmd/api/main.go; anything else editing means the template regressed

cards.title: Root + platform
items: the composition root wires everything with google/wire (compile-time codegen) — pgxpool built once, sitting behind PgBouncer transaction pooling
platform/authx mints HS256 access tokens and hashes bcrypt cost 10 over a pepper pre-hash that sidesteps the 72-byte cap
sqlc compiles each slice's queries.sql against migrations/ into committed internal/gen/db; make gen-check fails on drift, never hand-edit gen/** — transport DTOs validate with go-playground/validator

cards.title: Ports over imports
items: slices never import slices: shared capability gets promoted into internal/shared or platform/, or duplicated through a port — independence is the point, composition happens only in cmd/api
widgets publishes created/updated/deleted through the event-bus port; durable email/webhook work enqueues River jobs in the same transaction — no goroutine in a handler

depguard (lints/.golangci.yml) runs the law in CI: domain-pure, usecase-transport-free, slice-isolation, platform-no-features go red on a forbidden import — fix the shape, never //nolint:depguard an edge away

cards.title: The contract gates
items: the contract is unbreakable and non-waivable: developers cannot opt out, and neither can you. When a depguard rule fires, the fix is to re-cut the layout — never to weaken, rename, or delete the rule, and never to silence it with //nolint (that nolint is itself a review finding in go-review)

machine gate on these boundaries: golangci-lint depguard, four rules — domain-pure ($gostd + internal/shared only in domain.go), usecase-transport-free (chi, net/http, pgx stay in adapters), slice-isolation, platform-no-features — paired with scripts/check-lints.sh, which proves every rule fires from lints/check/'s violating files while the clean slice stays quiet (CI job: lints)

tests/contracts pins the stack wording across SKILL.md, the backend-go-stack digest, README and lints/.golangci.yml in lockstep; CI job: check (check-skill.py + unittest), CI job: examples (check-examples.py --require-toolchain compiles every Go example)
